verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents an official MCP server exposed at a public endpoint (mcp.helix-db.com/mcp) with defined tools like helix_execute_read_query requiring scoped permissions, plus a bootstrapper (`helix chef`) that installs MCP-related docs/skills for agent setup, and this is corroborated by an independent probe confirming the MCP doc page. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that an external agent (e.g., Claude/Cursor) successfully connects and operates via this MCP server, and more detail on the full tool surface beyond read queries.
